name: Ravens in the Dells
description:
A solo campaign in Bith na Bró. A cell of the [[Order of the White Raven]] ([[Albric van Lahlen|Albric]], [[Candure Lallensprit|Candure]] and [[Eivlyn Lallensprit|Eivlyn]]) works in [[the Dells]] to subvert the [[Engineers]]' rare-materials extraction in the [[Black Dunes|black dunes]].

- **Omen:** The moon turns a deep crimson, bathing the night in an eerie, blood-red light. Some say it heralds a time of chaos and strife, as the boundaries between the Wood and the mortal realm grow thin.
- **Travel:** the region is too varied (glaciers, beach, dells) for 2–3 days between any two places to ring true, so one watch is taken as roughly 30 km.
- **Adventure #1:** seeking [[Tomb of Incentus I|the tomb of Incentus I]], Lord of the Dells. He is not Albric's ancestor, but his ideals and writings are at the core of White Raven philosophy and, in rare and illicit tomes, thaumaturgy.
